image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a golden hamster (Syrian hamster) sitting on a soft, textured surface (likely bedding or fabric). The hamster is holding a peanut in its front paws and appears to be eating. The fur is a mix of golden-orange and white/cream, appearing slightly wet or matted on the head. There are scattered food debris (shells, seeds) around the subject.

One ear is clearly visible; it is rounded, relatively large compared to the head size, and covered in short dark fur, matching the taxonomy.
